0022600228.text: Washington, hosting as the home team in its 13th game of the season, is 4-8 and 11th in the East, 3 games back in the Southeast after losing its last five, while Detroit arrives 7-3, first in the Central and third in the East, having won its last game. The Wizards are without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and the Pistons are missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), with Ugonna Onyenso listed as day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. Detroit leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-111 win in Detroit on November 9, and Washington also lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
